AfterPlayerTakeQuest: We have a deal. Try to fulfil the terms of the contract in time.
AfterPlayerTakeQuest1: The contract is now in effect. Don't forget about the deadline. We are very specific about these things.
AfterPlayerTakeQuest2: A bargain is a bargain, so please make sure you fulfill your end on time.
BattlePlanetQuestCrashed: Attention! There was an error during planetary battle, data could be corrupted. Do you want to try and continue playing (it will be treated as victory in planetary battle)?

GotoPB: I've got nothing against you personally, <Player>, or I would have kicked you and broken all your legs long ago, but the pirates seem to have some kind of grudge against you. It's none of my business, but if I show you a credit of trust right now, their anger may transfer to me as well. And while you can easily escape them on your ship, I'm not particularly keen on the idea of my cold body ending up in a ditch somewhere. So if you want to get to the bottom of who's mad at you and why, head to the nearest pirate base and have at it.
Don't lose heart, brah! Instead, go down to the first floor and buy a few premium putrid meat pies from my granny. She hasn't been getting many customers...
Bribe.GotoPB1: Sorry, little bro, I ain't got much say around here. If you pissed off the pirates somehow, you need to take it up with them. Set course to the nearest pirate base and have it out with them.
Bribe.GotoPB2: I agree completely, dearest <Player>, and were it up to me I would totally rehabilitate you in the eyes of the pirate community. But I ain't got the muscle... I was put here to count money and lead, not to dole out justice for random passers-by. So if you want to clear things up and rehabilitate your good name, fly to a pirate base and lay down the law over there. But I don't need any trouble here, especially not with the heartburn I've had since morning.
Bribe.I_Bribe: The time has come to break the ice between us. Tell me straight -- what is it you want?
Bribe.I_Bribe1: I get the feeling that you don't like me. This must be corrected immediately!
Bribe.I_Bribe2: I feel that the barrier of misunderstandings between us must be demolished!
Bribe.No: I fear that kind of contribution is too much for me.
Bribe.No2: I'm not OK with bribing you or your government.
Bribe.Ok: Very well, I hope that this sum of <Money> cr will be used for the betterment of planet <Planet>!
Bribe.Question: A modest contribution of <Money> cr could lay the foundation for a long-term partnership. You can't even imagine how many poor folk would benefit from your generosity.
Bribe.Question1:
The Second Galactic War is in full swing, and the budget expenditures of our planet are getting out of hand.
Should you choose to contribute a sum of cr to our account, we may reconsider our position on you and your activities.
Bribe.Question2: I cannot imagine there would be any misunderstandings upon your contribution of <Money> cr to our account. In fact, such an act would greatly strengthen our relationship.
Bribe.Question3: Why don't you transfer a sum of <Money> cr to our account, <Player>? Methinks this could help our relationship quite a bit, don't you agree?
Bribe.QuestionNo: What do you want from us then? Your reputation with us shall remain unchanged until you pay or perform a feat of some sort.
Bribe.QuestionNo1: Dear <Player>, your reputation is not going to change on its own. Unless you become a renowned Galaxy hero, which I very much doubt is going to happen.
Bribe.QuestionOk: Why, certainly! This money will go toward a good cause. Your contribution equals but a fraction of our target sum to enact comprehensive education reform.
Bribe.QuestionOk1: Truly, your generosity knows no bounds. Rest assured that this money will go toward a good cause, one of many that our civilization is famous for!
Bribe.QuestionOk2: Have no doubt, your generous contribution will go toward building retirement communities and children's playgrounds. After a deduction for immediate military necessities, naturally.
Bribe.QuestionOk3:
Oh yes, this money will certainly be used for a good cause!
In fact, we aim to greatly strengthen the executive power and cut government bureaucracy. As you well understand, this kind of comprehensive reform requires considerable funds. Make sure to vote for the incumbent party in the next election!

BuyMap.GovAfterNo: If the price doesn't agree with you, feel free to go somewhere else. We're not going to haggle with you.
BuyMap.GovAfterNo1: You're not going to find a better price, you know... These maps are flying off the shelves lately.
GovAfterOk: The data on the star systems' coordinates is already transferred to your terminal. Your star maps have been updated.
BuyMap.GovAsk: We can offer a map of the <Name> constellation for only <Money> cr. Interested?
BuyMap.GovAsk1: Are you interested in purchasing a map of the <Name> constellation? It's priced at a mere <Money> cr. Do we have a deal or do you wish to haggle?

CheckQuest.Difficult: Harder conditions? In that case, you will earn more money!
CheckQuest.Easy: Easier conditions? Then you will earn less money!

DontQuest.Distrust:
We deal only with those rangers with whom we are on good terms.
And your reputation on this planet, , leaves much to be desired.
DontQuest.Distrust1:
Ranger! Our relations are a bit strained, don't you think?
Perhaps you should reevaluate your activities and make some much-needed changes.
DontQuest.Distrust2:
Would you charge an important mission to somebody you don't trust? Neither would we.
If you want us to give you a mission of significance, consider transferring a certain amount of money to our account so as to demonstrate the integrity of your intentions toward our planet.
DontQuest.WarInSystem: Our system is under attack by the enemies! While you're here twiddling your thumbs, other ships are perishing on the orbit! You must engage at once!
DontQuest.WarInSystem1:
Mission?! Are you serious, Ranger ?! If you keep wasting time, the next name entered into our list of cowards and deserters will be yours!
And quit looking at me like that! Now go and help your fellow rangers defend the system against the enemy invasion!
DontQuest.WarInSystemPirate: Are you deaf, <Player>? The system is under attack from all directions. While you're sitting here sipping coffee, our fellow pirates are dying! Enough chitchat -- it's time for battle!
DontQuest.WeDontHaveQuest: We currently do not have any missions for you. You can try again tomorrow.
DontQuest.WeDontHaveQuest1: We do not have any work for you at the moment, <Player>. Drop by tomorrow, maybe we'll have something then.
DontQuest.WeDontHaveQuest2: Terribly sorry, we have no missions for you today. But don't you worry, something urgent will surely pop up in a day or two.
DontQuest.YouHaveQuest: You still haven't completed the last mission we gave you. Quit wasting time.
DontQuest.YouHaveQuest1: Why do you want another mission? Aren't you still working on the last one? All you're doing is wasting time.
DontQuest.YouHaveQuest2: Don't try to multi-task. As soon as you complete the previous contract, we will discuss our future cooperation.

GovAfterBattlePlanetQuestClose: You did ask for a mission yourself, did you not, <Player>? Of course, this isn't our business. Taking part in planetary battles isn't part of the ranger job description. No, this job calls for the natural gift of command, the ability to sense and manage robots... And that is not something every random ranger can do.
Very well, will notify your brass at the ranger center that you shouldn't be offered this type of work in the futrure! You may go.
GovAfterPlanetQuestClose: To be sure, this mission is no walk in the park. But you are a ranger, are you not?! You've got to represent, <Player>!
But I suppose we can find another candidate for this mission. You may go.
GovAfterScript: And what are your plans for the future?

GuarantPrison.PlanetAfterNo: I agree completely, criminals should be kept in jail and nowhere else.
GuarantPrison.PlanetAfterOk: We'll take care of all required papers now and the prisoner will be at your disposal.
PlanetAsk: Our prisons are state of the art: motion detectors, infrared cameras, 24/7 patrols - upstanding citizens are fully protected from these criminals.

And I can only wonder why you want to disturb this "idyll". But it's not in my power to tell you what to do; the law allows for releasing prisoners on bail. Of course, the bail amount depends on the severity of the offense.
Please go ahead and review the list of our "guests":
GuarantPrison.PlayerAsk: I need to discuss a delicate matter concerning one of your prisoners
GuarantPrison.PlayerNo: Criminals should remain where they are, in jail.

I_PlanetBattleQuestClose: I refuse to take part. I'm not interested in this type of work!
I_PlanetBattleRejectAll: I never want to receive these kinds of missions!
I_PlanetBattleRejectAllConfirm: Are you sure, <Player>? If so, then you'll never be offered this type of work again!
I_PlanetBattleRejectAllConfirmAfterNo: All right, <Player>, it's good that you're not rushing with this kind of a decision. You still have time to think it over.
I_PlanetBattleRejectAllConfirmAfterYes: All right, <Player>, we will relay your wishes to the central database. You will no longer be bothered with similar requests.
I_PlanetBattleRejectAllConfirmNo: No, I've changed my mind, who knows what the future holds
I_PlanetBattleRejectAllConfirmYes: Yes, I'm sure, I don't want to see these kinds of missions again
I_PlanetQuestClose: I refuse to accept this mission.
I_Prison: This is a mistake, I'm a law-abiding citizen!
I_QueryQuest: Have you any special missions for me?

PirateClanPrison.GovAfterPrison: Well, <Player>, you served your sentence. And it doesn't matter what means you might have used. The important part is that you're free. Information about your term in the slammer has been sent out via proper channels, so you can relax -- it's all good.
PirateClanPrison.GovAfterPrisonNext: Now that you're out, we don't give a hoot what you're going to do, but still we hope that your actions will serve the pirate cause.
PirateClanPrison.GovBeforePrison: Keep in mind, <Player>, that you are an outlaw on our planet. You are to be arrested and convicted at once. The sentence will be executed immediately and cannot be appealed.
PirateClanPrison.PlayerGoToPrison: This is a mistake, I've been framed! Don't let me rot in prison!

PlanetBattle.GovAfterCancel:
Well, boy, I see you took to your heels the moment you first spotted the dominators, eh?
I'm gonna put your sorry ass in jail for the rest of your sorry life, ! I'll show you not to desert the battlefield!!!
PlanetBattle.GovAfterCancel1: What a shame, <Player>! You deserted the battlefield and breached the contract. Care to offer at least some excuse for your actions?
PlanetBattle.GovAfterCancel2: <Player>! You think it was a good idea to desert the battlefield? Do you know what we do to deserters and cowards?
PlanetBattle.GovAfterCancel3: I didn't expect this from you, <Player>! You seemed such a stand up guy, and then bam -- you're off the battlefield! We regret putting our trust in you... And you will regret it too!
GovBeforeBattle: Oh, yes, and one more thing. Might you need our help with this operation?
We can put a coat of armored nanites on the frames of your robots. With this armor the robots will withstand enemy attacks a lot better.

Or we can cooperate on an even higher level. Our transport choppers will already be supplying you with robot reinforcements regularly, but we can speed them up even more. But keep in mind that it will cost you.

Whatever your choice, make it quickly 'cause we need to be going. And don't forget that the cost of armored nanites or additional fuel for choppers will be deducted from your fee! Furthermore, you will gain more experience by securing victory without our aid...
GovBeforeBattleNoReinforcements: Oh, yes, and one more thing. Might you need our help with this operation?
We can put a coat of armored nanites on the frames of your robots. With this armor the robots will withstand enemy attacks a lot better.
But don't forget that the cost of armored nanites will be deducted from your fee! Furthermore, you will gain more experience by securing victory without our aid...
PlanetBattle.GovBeforeNormal: Hmm... It's good when a ranger can admit their mistakes. Now we'll just have to hire another ranger to do the job. Take care now.
PlanetBattle.GovBeforePrison: You want another go at it? We have plenty of other rangers for that, actual heroes. As for you... You should worry about your case going before the court-martial!
PlanetBattle.GovBeforePrison1: This conversation is over! Cowards harm the Coalition even more than the dominators. We don't stand on ceremony with the likes of you... Do you catch my drift?
PlanetBattle.GovBeforePrison2: You have the gall to demand that we trust you again?! Somebody fetch me a gun, I will shoot this bastard myself!..
PlanetBattle.GovBeforePrison3: We are not idiots for you to fool us twice! By the way, do you know what's done to traitors like you in times of war?..
PlanetBattle.GovBeforePrisonPirateClan: You want another go at it? We have plenty of other rangers for that, actual heroes. As for you... You should worry about your case going before the court-martial!
PlanetBattle.GovBeforePrisonPirateClan1: This conversation is over! Cowards harm the Coalition even more than the dominators. We don't stand on ceremony with the likes of you... Do you catch my drift?
PlanetBattle.GovBeforePrisonPirateClan2: You have the gall to demand that we trust you again?! Somebody fetch me a gun, I will shoot this bastard myself!..
PlanetBattle.GovBeforePrisonPirateClan3: We are not idiots for you to fool us twice! By the way, do you know what's done to traitors like you in times of war?..
PlanetBattle.PlayerAfterCancelNormal: I don't have an excuse. I fled because I failed the mission. I guess it was too much for me.
PlanetBattle.PlayerAfterCancelPrison: I fought like a lion! It's those damn robots! They couldn't follow even the simplest orders! Give me another chance!
PlanetBattle.PlayerAfterCancelPrison1: I am not going to justify my actions. Today just isn't my day. If I could have another shot at it, I know I'll get it done!
PlanetBattle.PlayerAfterCancelPrison2: Try fighting them yourself! Those dominators are beasts on the battlefield! But if you insist, I guess I can give it another shot...
PlanetBattle.PlayerAfterCancelPrison3: Nobody's perfect, eh? Give me another chance, and I'll show them what's what!
PlanetBattle.PlayerAfterCancelPrison4: That was no shameful desertion, but rather a tactical retreat aimed at disorienting the enemy! And quite successful, I might add, even you believed it! Now all I need is to launch a repeat offensive on the dominator positions to secure victory...
PlanetBattle.PlayerBeforeBattleDamage: I want the additive to the titanium alloy! No time to waste, let's head out!
PlanetBattle.PlayerBeforeBattleHelp: I need fire support, keep those reinforcements coming.
PlanetBattle.PlayerBeforeBattleNone: I don't need any help. I intend to get as much experience as I can out of this, and I could use the extra money.
PlanetBattle.PlayerGoToPrison: No, please don't shoot me! I'm not going to fail you again! In fact, I will go on to greatly contribute to the cause of liberating the Galaxy from the dominators!
PlanetBattle.PlayerGoToPrison1: You're making a big mistake! I'm begging you, give me another chance! I want to redeem myself with a glorious victory! Hold me back before I start bashing those dominator mugs with my bare fists...
PlanetBattle.PlayerGoToPrison2: A-a-a!!! No, don't, I want to live! I implore you to spare me!
PlanetBattle.PlayerGoToPrison3: Hold on, let's settle this peacefully! We are all civilized citizens, are we not! I promise to correct my ways... I am already on the path to rehabilitation! See how firm my grasp is on this path -- even these two guards can't drag me off it! Please, won't you temper justice with mercy!
PlanetBattle.PlayerGoToPrison4: You can't even imagine what the Coalition will lose in me! I beg you, give me a chance to redeem myself! I will become the greatest soldier in the Galaxy, I swear it!..

Prison.GovAfterPrison: Now you are a law-abiding citizen. We have submitted a report of your good behavior to all the planetary archives. From this moment on you will be a welcomed guest on any planet, assuming you don't go back to criminality. Good luck in your new life, <Player>.
Prison.GovAfterPrisonNext: So how are you going to start your new life? I hope you've learned your lesson here!!
Prison.GovBeforePrison: Let it be known to you, <Player>, that you are deemed a criminal on this planet. You will be arrested and convicted at once. The sentence will be executed immediately and cannot be appealed.
Prison.PlayerGoToPrison: This is a mistake, I'm a law-abiding citizen!
